# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU, Skia m152, and memory fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the engine to Skia m152 and ships Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. The new Graphite rendering pipeline is now available for all three GPU backends. Several native memory safety fixes land alongside further performance improvements and Nano Server FreeType font support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — The engine is now built from Skia chrome/m152, bringing the latest upstream rendering improvements and GPU fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))
- **Upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes merged** — An additional upstream sync from the chrome/m151 branch applies engine stability improvements before the m152 update. ([#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering pipeline. Consumers can now create Graphite GPU contexts for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, unlocking the modern lower-overhead GPU path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async ReadPixels API lets callers read pixel data from GPU-backed images and surfaces without blocking the render thread, working across all supported GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package added** — A new NuGet package wraps the Silk.NET Vulkan interop layer, making it straightforward to wire up Vulkan contexts without custom P/Invoke boilerplate. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Solution files converted to .slnx format** — All .sln solution files are converted to the new .slnx format, improving IDE compatibility and reducing merge conflicts. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **Binding generation is now deterministic across platforms** — The binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host OS, eliminating spurious diffs when regenerating on different machines. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator fixed** — The SpanIterator held a raw pointer into the parent SKRegion. If the parent was collected first the pointer dangled. The region is now kept alive for the iterator's lifetime. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed** — SKPixmap methods that return a derived pixmap were not rooting the pixel-source object, allowing it to be collected while the derived pixmap was still in use. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — A native pixel buffer allocated during raster image creation was not freed when the native call failed, causing a silent native memory leak. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check cached** — The per-type reflection check that decides whether to skip handle registration was repeated on every object construction. It is now cached per type, eliminating repeated reflection overhead in object-creation hot paths. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy** — SKData.SaveTo previously copied data into an intermediate buffer before writing. The copy is now avoided, halving memory usage on this path. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **GetEncodedText avoids intermediate string allocation** — The null-terminated fast path in GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes uniform lookup map** — The uniform lookup map is now pre-sized to the known uniform count, eliminating resizing overhead. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **FreeType font rendering on Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server environments lack the GDI font stack. SkiaSharp now falls back to FreeType on Nano Server, enabling text rendering in containerised Windows workloads that was previously broken. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test targets added** — Containerised CI test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server validate SkiaSharp on production-relevant Linux environments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Windows MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once per build rather than once per compilation unit, significantly reducing native build times on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
